LLM auditresponse for 013-Makefile.patch:
<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
This file is a standard patch (diff) for the VirtualBox host kernel module Makefile. It makes two well-known compatibility changes:

1. Replaces `KERNELRELEASE` with `KBUILD_EXTMOD` to detect the kbuild build context. `KERNELRELEASE` is no longer reliably set in all out-of-tree module build scenarios in newer Linux kernels, so `KBUILD_EXTMOD` is the recommended replacement.
2. Updates `$(CURDIR)` references to `$(KBUILD_EXTMOD)` for locating sub-module Makefiles (vboxnetflt, vboxnetadp, vboxpci), since `KBUILD_EXTMOD` correctly reflects the out-of-tree build path passed via `M=`.

The patch is purely a build-system adjustment. It contains no network operations, no obfuscated code, no shell command execution, no file system modifications, and no introduction of new tools or scripts. It does not deviate from standard upstream patching practices for VirtualBox's kernel module build system and is consistent with widely-known fixes for building against modern kernels.
</details>
<evidence>
</evidence>
<summary>
Standard VirtualBox kbuild compatibility patch; no security concerns.</summary>
</security_assessment>
